notes.title: STATISTICS BUG PATCH
notes.content:
[b]Attention Survivors:[/b]
We've just pushed a quick update to resolve an issue with the in-game statistics. If you've experienced any discrepancies in your stat tracking, the problem should now be fixed.

As always, if you encounter any new issues or have feedback, please reach out on Discord.

Thank you for your support and patience—let's keep fighting the undead!
